name: Starstruck
source:
Kenta, a high school boy who acts as captain of the judo team, is struggling with both relationships and finances. 

After weeks of trying and failing to find a job to cover transportation costs for an upcoming tournament, life takes a turn when the K-pop star Choi enrolls in his semester. While everyone else is excited, Kenta is left the odd man out, as he just can’t understand how people can put him over all the other excellent bands of the year (cough cough trash panda). 

But what will happen when this diva of a superstar takes an interest in us…?

[Edited from [url=https://circodinamita.itch.io/starstruck]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
高中柔道隊隊長健太最近煩心事不少，感情不順，手頭也緊。

為了湊齊參加下一場比賽的路費，他接連找了好幾個星期的工作，處處碰壁。偏偏這學期，韓國流行偶像Choi又轉了進來。大家都興奮得不行，只有健太格格不入。今年明明有那麼多出色的樂團（咳咳，比如Trash Panda），他實在想不通大家怎麼就獨獨迷上這位。

可要是這位愛耍大牌的巨星反過來對健太有了興趣呢……？
